implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired design using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted OpenAI model gpt-5-mini (temperature=0.0). Use the shared_initial_candidate generation semantics: one deterministic initial generation call per task (shared between conditions) and at most one guarded repair call per task when deterministic validation fails. All scoring, hashing, validation, retry logic, exclusion, and analysis are automated per the adapter contract and preregistration; no human review or external resources are used.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic synthetic intent→configuration generator using provided seeds; SHA256 hashing of each generated task instance recorded. Pairing preserved; task order randomized with fixed seed 42 for execution ordering only.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use registered transformation IDs: direct_configuration_generation_v1 for baseline and generate_validate_repair_v1 for guarded. Deterministic parser and serializer enforce syntax; verifier feedback encoded as JSON primitives. All transformations logged and hashed.
randomisation_plan: Within each execution run, task execution order randomized with fixed RNG seed 42. Pairing preserved (each task executed once per condition).
caching_plan: Deterministic caching of (task_hash → initial_generation_output) and emulator image hashes; reuse cached initial generation outputs only when hash matches. No external vector DBs or GPU-based caches used.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated infra-retry policy: up to 2 deterministic retries for transient emulator or API failures. If one condition of a pair exhausts retries and the other completes, mark pair incomplete and exclude from primary (complete-pair) analysis. All failures logged with deterministic failure codes (infra-failure, API_quota, parser_error).
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (primary confirmatory schema as provided by adapter contract)
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated calls: per-task 1 initial generation + up to 1 repair = 1–2 calls. Expect ~50% tasks requiring a repair → expected_calls_per_task=1.5 → estimated_model_calls=200×1.5=300. Maximum_model_calls = task_count×2 = 400. Expected wall-clock ≤7 days under hosted API rate limits; monitor and halt if adapter max_model_calls (400) or manifest wall-clock cap (7 days) reached.
